    <div style="text-align:center">
              
            <div class="field field--name-field-content-image field--type-entity-reference field--label-hidden field__item"><article class="media media--type-image media--view-mode-hero">
  
                      <img loading="eager" src="/sites/default/files/styles/content-885x432/public/research/homepage-carousel-03.jpg.webp?h=ca676f71&itok=cdNsnt3n" width="885" height="432" alt="Welcome to Bastion: warzone ethnography with the combat surgeons " typeof="foaf:Image" class="campl-scale-with-grid image-style-content-885x432" />

    <div class="node__content cam-content-container">
            
      
      
            <div class="clearfix text-formatted field field--name-body field--type-text-with-summary field--label-hidden field__item"><p>In Cambridge, we are committed to achieving excellence in research and scholarship, and to ensuring that our research contributes to the well-being of society. We seek to provide a creative and supportive environment in which ideas are generated and can flourish. The excellence and diversity of our research across the Schools of <a href="https://www.csah.cam.ac.uk/">Arts & Humanities</a>, <a href="https://www.cshss.cam.ac.uk/">Humanities & Social Sciences</a>, <a href="https://www.medschl.cam.ac.uk/">Clinical Medicine</a>, <a href="https://www.tech.cam.ac.uk/">Technology</a>, <a href="https://www.physsci.cam.ac.uk/">Physical Sciences</a> and <a href="https://www.bio.cam.ac.uk/">Biological Sciences</a>, and our role as one of the founder members of the <a href="https://www.cambridgenetwork.co.uk/">Cambridge Network</a>, means that in addition to our achievements in fundamental research, we are also well-positioned to make significant contributions to the global innovation agenda and, by conveying the implications of our research, to contribute to the formulation of policy.</p>

<p>In addition to the activities ongoing within the six Schools, we have identified a number of <a href="/research/research-at-cambridge/strategic-research-initiatives-networks" data-entity-substitution="canonical" data-entity-type="node" data-entity-uuid="beff67fd-d188-4108-938c-f9ac373cf372" title="Strategic Research Initiatives & Networks">Strategic Research Initiatives & Networks</a> and <a href="https://www.cam.ac.uk/node/179362">Interdisciplinary Research Centres</a> which build on the existing research base in Cambridge to tackle challenges that can only be addressed by multi-disciplinary teams of researchers. Our aim is to provide academic leadership in these areas and to develop strategic partnerships around the world to advance research, and the impact of that research, in these fields.</p></div>

Chickens Guinea pigs Equine species Mice Naked mole-rats Non-human primates (marmosets) Other birds Rats Sheep Xenopus Zebrafish Non-technical summaries Animal Welfare Policy Concordat on Openness on Animal Research Alternatives to animal use FAQs Further information Research culture Narrative CVs project Open research Strategic Initiatives and Networks Interdisciplinary Research Centres Energy sector partnerships Nobel Prize Horizons magazine Research integrity Research integrity overview Statement Reports Advisory panel Procedures Resources Good Research Practice guidance Good Research Practice checklist Guidelines on authorship Citing blogs as reference sources Research misconduct Business and enterprise Our impact   Research at Cambridge Section - Research About research Animal research Research culture Open research Strategic Initiatives and Networks Interdisciplinary Research Centres Energy sector partnerships Nobel Prize Horizons magazine Research home News Our people Research integrity Business and enterprise Our impact In Cambridge, we are committed to achieving excellence in research and scholarship, and to ensuring that our research contributes to the well-being of society. We seek to provide a creative and supportive environment in which ideas are generated and can flourish. The excellence and diversity of our research across the Schools of Arts & Humanities , Humanities & Social Sciences , Clinical Medicine , Technology , Physical Sciences and Biological Sciences , and our role as one of the founder members of the Cambridge Network , means that in addition to our achievements in fundamental research, we are also well-positioned to make significant contributions to the global innovation agenda and, by conveying the implications of our research, to contribute to the formulation of policy. In addition to the activities ongoing within the six Schools, we have identified a number of Strategic Research Initiatives & Networks and Interdisciplinary Research Centres which build on the existing research base in Cambridge to tackle challenges that can only be addressed by multi-disciplinary teams of researchers. Our aim is to provide academic leadership in these areas and to develop strategic partnerships around the world to advance research, and the impact of that research, in these fields. Media enquiries Media enquiries may be directed to External Affairs and Communications . Search research Keyword search Go Sign up to receive our weekly research email Receive our selection of the week's biggest Cambridge research news directly in your inbox. Enter your email address, confirm you're happy to receive our emails and then select 'Subscribe'. Email I wish to receive a weekly Cambridge research news summary by email. The University of Cambridge will use your email address to send you our weekly research news email. We are committed to protecting your personal information and being transparent about what information we hold. Please read our email privacy notice for details.
